The 256GB SSD ensures fast boot times and quick access to your files and programmes, making your workflow more efficient. The set includes a stunning 21.5-inch Full HD IPS monitor featuring a 100Hz refresh rate and 1ms response time, providing crisp visuals with vibrant colours and smooth motion. The IPS panel technology offers wide viewing angles, whilst the frameless design creates an immersive viewing experience. With Full HD 1080p resolution and support for 16.7 million colours, everything from documents to multimedia content looks sharp and detailed. Pre-installed with Windows 10 and Google Chrome, you're ready to start working or browsing immediately. The package includes everything you need: a WiFi dongle for wireless connectivity, a comfortable keyboard and mouse for input, and speakers for audio output.
